I suppose this feature wouldn't be too different from the OpenAI GPT Chat plugin already available as an add-on, but this feature would incorporate the context of the godot editor, which may require some core integration.

I know its a big ask, but I believe this feature would put godot ahead of every other game development engine alive today. Dealing with bugs and errors is the biggest force causing would-be developers to give up. If that was easy, it would clear the tightest bottleneck in the game development process.
